name: baton
description: Switch between multiple AI coding accounts across editors, with one shared conversation history.

scripts.gui:dev: pnpm build:cli && cd gui/src-tauri && cargo tauri dev
scripts.gui:build: pnpm build:cli && cd gui/src-tauri && cargo tauri build
scripts.gui:build:standalone: pnpm build:cli && bash scripts/prepare-standalone.sh && cd gui/src-tauri && cargo tauri build --config tauri.standalone.conf.json
